mapper.select: SELECT /* homes.system.mapper.SystemMapper.selectDomainListCount */ COUNT(1) AS T_CNT FROM TB_CM_DOMAINS

SELECT /* homes.system.mapper.SystemMapper.selectDomainList */ COL_NM AS COLNM , COL_COMMENT AS COLCOMMENT , COL_DATA_TY AS COLDATA_TY , COL_DATA_SIZE AS COLDATA_SIZE , COL_SIZE AS COLSIZE , CREAT_DE AS CREATDE , SOURCE_CD AS SOURCECD , SOURCE_NM AS SOURCENM , CREAT_ID AS CREATID FROM TB_CM_DOMAINS LIMIT #{stno}, #{edno}

SELECT /* homes.system.mapper.SystemMapper.selectExistsDomain */ #{colnm} AS COLNM , #{colcomment} AS COLCOMMENT , COL_DATA_TY AS COLDATA_TY , COL_DATA_SIZE AS COLDATA_SIZE , COL_SIZE AS COLSIZE , CREAT_DE AS CREATDE , SOURCE_CD AS SOURCECD , SOURCE_NM AS SOURCENM , CREAT_ID AS CREATID , CASE WHEN COUNT(1) > 0 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS EXISTS_YN FROM TB_CM_DOMAINS WHERE COL_NM = #{colnm}
SELECT /* homes.system.mapper.SystemMapper.selectTotalLedgrCount */ COUNT(1) AS CNT FROM TB_BD_TOTAL_TITLLEDGR

SELECT /* homes.system.mapper.SystemMapper.selectTotalLedgr */ BULD_REGSTR_PK AS REGSTRPK , REGSTR_GB_NM AS REGSTRGBNM , NW_OD_GB_CD AS NWODGBNM , PLOT_LOC AS PLOTLOC , BULD_NM AS BULDNM , MAIN_PPS_CD_NM AS MPPSNM , ETC_PPS AS ETCPPS , HSHLD_CO AS HSHLDCO , FMLY_CO AS FMLYCO , CREAT_DE AS CREATDE , DATE_FORMAT(CREAT_DT, '%Y.%m.%d') AS REGSTRDE FROM TB_BD_TOTAL_TITLLEDGR LIMIT #{stno}, #{edno}
